name: Sekiyado (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sekiyado town emblem in light blue: a ring open at the top and bottom enclosing a stylised device of curved strokes.
history: Flag of the former town of Sekiyado in Chiba Prefecture, dissolved on 2003-06-06. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 September 1985.

features.role: Sekiyado town emblem — a ring open at the top and bottom enclosing a stylised device of curved strokes
